MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_SHATT: Exhaust. Add Crystal Daggers to your hand; the card shows how many.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_APOCA: Apply one random effect: 2 Vulnerable, 2 Weak, 5 Poison, 10 Doom, 3 Demise, 1 Imbalanced, or 1 Strangle.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_CRYST: When you take unblocked damage, Exhaust a Sovereign Shield.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_STANC:
After playing, cycle through Light Swing → Sweep → Heavy Chop → Light Swing.
Light Swing: Costs 1 less Energy and deals 80% damage.
Sweep: Attacks ALL enemies; attacks twice with [gold]Seeking Edge[/gold].
Heavy Chop: Costs 1 more Energy and deals 120% damage; if damage gets through Block, Stun the target for 2 turns.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_HEAT_:
Cannot be played in any way.
When generated, add Charges bound to this cannon. Play them all to become [gold]Hot Start[/gold].
The card shows the number required. A full hand sends Charges to the discard pile.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_BLESS:
When played, gain one random effect per Blessing:
2 Strength, 2 Dexterity, 2 Radiance, 3 Regen, 6 Vigor, 1 Curious, or 1 Barricade.
MORE_WEAPONS_REGENT_EXTEND_KEYWORD_MARTI: When generated, Exhaust all Basic Attacks in this combat and gain [gold]Martial Fanatic[/gold].
